				<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">POB Digital Products is looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Digital Product Manager to help manage our growing store of digital products. The role involves organizing products, improving product presentation, supporting uploads, and making sure our digital store is well structured and easy for customers to use.</p>
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">The ideal candidate should understand digital products, online stores, product organization, and basic e-commerce operations. You will help ensure that product information is accurate, product files are properly arranged, and the store remains clean, professional, and easy to navigate.</p>
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">This role is a good fit for someone who is organized, proactive, and able to work with minimal supervision. You should be comfortable handling product details, coordinating updates, and helping improve how digital products are displayed and sold on the platform.</p>
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul class="marker:text-quiet list-disc pl-8">
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Manage and organize digital product listings.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Review product titles, descriptions, and categories.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Support the upload and update of digital products.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Ensure product files, images, and download links are properly arranged.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Improve product presentation and store structure.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Assist with product packaging and basic optimization.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Help maintain quality and consistency across the store.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Support day-to-day digital store operations.</p>
</li>
</ul>

<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Experience with digital products, e-commerce, or online store management.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Strong attention to detail.</p>
</li>
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Good communication and organizational skills.</p>

<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2">Ability to work independently.</p>

				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
								<div class="service-detail-description ">
				<p>I will edit a product explanatory video that helps your audience understand your brand’s offer in a clear, engaging, and professional way. The final video will be polished, easy to follow, and structured to highlight your product’s features, benefits, and value in a way that keeps viewers interested. Explainer-style videos work best when the message is simple, the pacing is tight, and the visuals support the story well.</p>
<p>Whether you need the video for your website, social media, ads, or product presentation, I will shape your raw clips, product footage, voiceover, and text into a compelling final video. I can add transitions, captions, motion graphics, music, and visual emphasis to make the explanation more attractive and persuasive. The goal is to give your product a professional presentation that improves understanding and helps convert viewers into customers.</p>
<p>This service is ideal for brands that want to explain what they sell, demonstrate how it works, and build trust with potential buyers. I focus on clear storytelling, smooth editing, and a clean visual style so the final result feels modern and effective</p>

				<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2"><strong>Description</strong><br />
We are looking for a detail-oriented freelancer to help upload, organize, and optimize products on a Shopify store. The role includes improving product titles, descriptions, images, categories, and overall product presentation to make the store look more professional and conversion-ready.</p>
<p class="my-2 [&+p]:mt-4 [&_strong:has(+br)]:inline-block [&_strong:has(+br)]:pb-2"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul class="marker:text-quiet list-disc pl-8">
<li class="py-0 my-0 prose-p:pt-0 prose-p:mb-2 prose-p:my-0 [&>p]:pt-0 [&>p]:mb-2 [&>p]:my-0">
